title: Semi-submersible module (schematic of the 2026 concept study type) beside our box pontoon

provenance.basis: Illustrative archetype for projects/floating-city-design-challenge (scenario SCN_FLOATCITY_COASTAL_01); not an engineering design. Schematic only (CLM_062): pontoons under water, columns through the surface, a raised deck; proportions chosen for legibility and to stay above the 15 m seabed of the bay site, not from the study. Beside it, our first platform (Design A, three storeys, draft 2.958 m from analysis/results.json) for the comparison of B33.
